Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, pt As Object, s As String, f As Object, flt As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Name = "data"
    ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("Region", "Product", "Amount")
    ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array("East", "Pen", 10)
    ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array("East", "Ink", 20)
    ws.Range("A4:C4").Value = Array("West", "Pen", 30)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=ws)
    ws.Name = "report"
    Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, "data!R1C1:R4C3").CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("A3"), "P")
    pt.PivotFields("Region").Orientation = xlRowField
    pt.PivotFields("Product").Orientation = xlRowField
    pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("Amount"), "Sum of Amount", xlSum
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionBeginsWith, Value1:="E"
    Case 1
        pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionBeginsWith, Value1:="E": pt.PivotFields("Product").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionContains, Value1:="n"
    Case 2
        pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionBeginsWith, Value1:="E": pt.PivotFields("Product").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionContains, Value1:="n": pt.PivotFields("Product").PivotFilters(1).Order = 1
    Case 3
        pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionBeginsWith, Value1:="E": pt.PivotFields("Product").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionContains, Value1:="n": pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters(1).Order = 2
    Case 4
        pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionBeginsWith, Value1:="E": pt.PivotFields("Product").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionContains, Value1:="n": pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters(1).Order = 3
    Case 5
        pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionBeginsWith, Value1:="E": pt.PivotFields("Product").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionContains, Value1:="n": pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters(1).Order = 0
    Case 6
        pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionBeginsWith, Value1:="E": pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters(1).Order = 1
    Case 7
        pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionBeginsWith, Value1:="E": pt.PivotFields("Product").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionContains, Value1:="n": pt.PivotFields("Region").ClearAllFilters
    Case 8
        pt.PivotFields("Product").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionContains, Value1:="n": pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotFilters.Add2 xlCaptionBeginsWith, Value1:="E"
    Case 9
        s = TypeName(pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotItems.Add("North"))
    Case 10
        pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotItems.Add "North": s = pt.PivotFields("Region").PivotItems.Count & "," & pt.TableRange1.Rows.Count
    End Select
    For Each f In pt.RowFields
        For Each flt In f.PivotFilters: s = s & "|" & f.Name & ":" & flt.FilterType & ":" & flt.Order: Next
    Next
    Tried = "ok " & s
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 10
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
